title: Enhancement: [DRH] Define baseline tests to run/skip for new DRH topologies
author: Javier-Tan
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

High

### Description of the enhancement

Introducing new DRH topologies, we need to create a baseline for which tests are run or skipped via test topology markers and conditional markers.

As a starting baseline, we want to mimic what UT2 runs. Do this by attaching new topo types ('lrh', 'urh') to where we see UT2 (topo type T2 etc.)

### Current Behavior

DRH toplogies, LRH & URH, is not mentioned in any conditional or topology markers

### Proposed Behavior

At a baseline, LRH & URH should run the same tests as UT2

linkedPullRequests.title: For new DRH topologies, add topologies and conditional markers that allow us to run same tests as UT2
linkedPullRequests.author: Javier-Tan
